name: CDC Hume 4 (HU4)
notes: Hume Campus Two, building 1. Infratil 2022 gives 29 MW, completion 2019; Baxtel says opened 2020. Address given as 5 or 7 Tralee St depending on source. MW may be campus-allocated rather than IT.

name: CDC Hume 5 (HU5)
notes: Hume Campus Two, building 2 (campus 51 MW = HU4 29 + HU5 22). Under construction in 2022 per Infratil; Baxtel says opened 2023. DA 202038149 (3-storey data centre with link bridge to buildings 4 and 5, 5 Tralee St, notified 2021) may relate to HU5 but unconfirmed.

name: CDC Hume 6 (HU6)
address: 62 Sawmill Circuit / 5 Tralee Street, Hume ACT 2620
notes: Two-storey data centre on blocks 99 and 103; ~20 MVA site electrical demand (IT MW not stated). DA lodged Oct 2024, notified to Mar 2025; approval decision not directly confirmed, but Infratil Sep 2025 investor day shows HU6 as campus expansion in progress.

name: CDC Beard 1 (BE1)
notes: Fourth CDC Canberra campus (listed by some as Jerrabomberra). CDC site lists campus 39 MW; ABC Aug 2026 says 40 MW and 'still being fitted out'; CDC Mar 2026 presentation says work at BE1 completed. Status borderline operational/fit-out; year likely 2025-26. Infratil 2025 cites 110 MW for Beard (likely whole campus). planning_ref inferred from civil drawing file name.

name: CDC Fyshwick 2 (FY2)
notes: Completed 2018 (month unknown) - may fall before the 2018-09-01 cutoff. Announced 20 MW in 2017; Infratil 2022 lists 26 MW.

name: NEXTDC A1 Adelaide
notes: Opened Sep 2024. Tech specs give 5 MW total planned IT; originally announced as 10 MW (2022). DCD gives address as 211 Pirie St (same block, corner Frome/Pirie).

name: NEXTDC D1 Darwin
notes: Opened Aug 2024; 7+ MW design capacity but ~1 MW initially built. Address conflicts across sources (2 Harvey St vs Ryko Court).

name: NEXTDC D2 Darwin
notes: Topped out Mar 2026; completion targeted 1HFY27 (by Dec 2026). Address given as 2 Harvey St (DCD) or 2-6 Ryko Court (datacentermap).

name: Firmus Project Southgate Stage 1 (Launceston AI Factory)
notes: Approved by Launceston City Council Sep 2025. Stage 1a 44 MW + Stage 1b to 90 MW combined (could be split into two rows); 104 MW grid demand. Originally targeted mid-2026; ABC Jun 2026 says operational early 2027. Stage 2 (300 MW) not yet approved - see excluded.

name: Firmus Bell Bay AI Data Centre
address: Bell Bay Advanced Manufacturing Zone (former Gunns pulp mill site), Long Reach
notes: George Town Council approved 25 Aug 2026 (6-1). Reported as 288 MW, but unclear whether IT or grid demand, so mw_it left blank. Two data halls. Firmus appealed generator conditions to TASCAT on 10 Sep 2026. Construction not started.
